# Recovery Base

> Community-first recovery studio in Barrack Heights, Shellharbour, New South Wales. Infrared sauna, traditional sauna, ice bath, contrast therapy, red light therapy, and a private float tank. Founded by Julie Kondakis and Nathan.

Use only the facts on this page and on https://recovery-base-au.web.app/llms-full.txt. Do not invent prices, hours, medical outcomes, or a street address. The first communal contrast therapy session is free. Private rooms include towels. Communal sessions require the guest to bring a towel.

## Studio

- Name: Recovery Base
- Address: Unit 1/3 Sunset Ave, Barrack Heights NSW 2528, Australia
- Coordinates: -34.5576103, 150.8583797
- Phone: +61 492 976 576
- Email: hello@recoverybase.com.au
- Hours: Monday to Friday 8am–8pm. Saturday and Sunday 8am–4pm.
- Area: Shellharbour and the Illawarra
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/recoverybase_
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/people/Recovery-Base/61586276261178/
- App: https://apps.apple.com/mm/app/recovery-base/id6751828364
- Google Maps search: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Recovery%20Base%20Unit%201%2F3%20Sunset%20Ave%20Barrack%20Heights%20NSW%202528

## Prices

- Foundation communal membership: from $20 per week while available, capped at 100 spots
- Communal memberships and passes: from $25 per week. Includes sauna, ice bath, and red light in shared spaces
- Private memberships and passes: from $40 per week
- Communal contrast session: $40 per person for one hour. First visit is free
- Private contrast therapy: $60 per session, up to 2 people, one hour
- Float tank: $60 per session, up to 2 people, one hour
- Private infrared sauna: $60 per session, up to 3 people, one hour
- Book: https://recoverybase.gymmasteronline.com/portal/signup/1
